string_step_plans.law:
Batch 1 step plans (Scimitar LP1/RP2-only strings, 2026-10-25). Engine: fighter.js _attackClipPlan step-plan branch (from #1096). A step plays its row ONLY when status is verified (button bitmask + stance + throw gates pass, plus the Job 1 limb-peak proxy except in jump context). review/unmapped steps play NO bank row - never a donor/generic row - and are flagged in _atkPlan.unmapped. T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Scimitar-Batch-1 entry): scimitar's T3 bank is jin (t3_source jin, t3_bank moveset_jin.json, verified from the file on BOTH #1096 and main + the t3/ directory listing + Job 1 bank jin (220 rows) + Job 2 scimitar entries all bank jin (362) + Job 4 jin candidates (47)). Bank resolution, documented not assumed: scimitar's T7/T8 base is Shaheen (tekken_base Shaheen, merge_sources t8/t7 shaheen) and Shaheen debuted in Tekken 7, so NO shaheen dir exists under t3/ — this bank is a FALLBACK, not native (the kinpo pattern: Asuka -> jin; contrast phantom Yoshimitsu -> yoshimitsu native, burger Bob -> bryan). The pack dir does NOT differ from the moveset bank name here (unlike diablo's heihachi/heihachi_on_jin split). Jin-bank rules, per-bank evidence (never a cross-bank blanket ban; demonio/kinpo adjudicated this same bank independently, re-derived here): row 35 EXISTS as a starts-airborne LP1 row (hit_frames [11,12,39,535,0,1]) — ground-rejected, jump-context only; row 220 is a STANDING RP2 row (hit_frames [12,12,41,1042,0,2], Job 1 standing, armR, level h) — NOT king's jumping chord row, NOT bryan's button-0 row, NOT heihachi's jump RK4 row; row 216 is a JUMP row (hit_frames [63,64,117,1543,0,0], button 0) — it fails every single-button gate; row 41 is a starts-airborne LP1 row. Scimitar's own LP1 move 1 carries t3_row 184 on #1096 (standing LP1 row) and its RP2 move 2 carries t3_row 220 on #1096 (the standing RP2 row above). Move 1 IS row-changed on current main (184->None, anim_ref None), so both Batch 1 steps with prefix 1 (1,2 step 1, 1,2,2 step 1) are SUSPENDED-DRIFT (stale row 184 documented, never wired). Move 2 is damage-only drift (4->10), NOT suspending. The file's ONLY row-changed move is 1 (184->None). Standing rows verified for crouch-context steps (d+1+2 family rows 92/93/183) follow the demonio Batch 1 precedent: the pipeline stance gate flags crouch rows for non-crouch steps, not standing rows for crouch steps (GATE-NOTE on each such step; re-adjudicate if the gate tightens). Job 3 fills wired: 0 (all Job 3 candidates are ROW-ONLY or soft, documented never wired; the two exact ROW-ONLY rows 92/105 for prefix 1 are moot — the step is suspended on drift regardless). No agreement note fires: the note fires ONLY for actually-wired gate candidates disagreeing with an exact+FULL Job 3 candidate, and no exact+FULL Job 3 candidate exists for any verified step. Dedupe fires zero times: no Batch 1 step prefix shares a pass-all row between its plain and __main Job 3 targets. Job 4 joins: 0 (no jin Job 4 candidate is carried by a scimitar Job 2 own-row entry for any Batch 1 step prefix). 15 orphans: jin Job 4 candidates no scimitar Job 2 move carries (any step). Gap-1: main jin hit_frames blob 54b38e63... and skeleton blob 26f72eb7... are IDENTICAL on #1096 and current main; main jin rows.pack blob 7bafa36a... (226 rows) = #1096 rows.pack blob 141fbc8d... (220 rows) + exactly the 6 #1109 bake jin rows (89/112/247/288/339/357), SUPERSET, 0 removed — and every wired row is present in the current main pack. Canonicalization is the CORRECTED rule (strip only a trailing ~t[378] source-variant suffix): scimitar Batch 1 contains ZERO input-~ canonicals, and scimitar is INERT file-wide on this axis — every ~ in the file is a trailing source-variant suffix (~t7.shaheen / ~t8.shaheen, with .2/.3), so old canonical == corrected canonical for all 114 comma keys. Spelling quirks kept: d/b+2,1 vs db+2,1 are distinct canonicals (both unmapped-all, different step-1 drift evidence: damage-only vs anim_ref-changed). Most unmapped steps have NO candidate at all: their intermediate prefixes are T8-sourced with no T3 row, so the correct clips come from #988 Step 2 (original T8 refs) or future extraction, never from a T3 row recorded as correct. Full gate evidence in docs/movesets/SCIMITAR-BATCH1-STEP-PLANS-2026-10-25.md.
